trust.remote_metadata_policy: allow public sources and explicitly authorized private analytics readback; forbid credentials

permissions.network: none in the bundled CLI; external research and provider operations require separate tools and scope
permissions.file_write: user-selected project artifacts and project content only
permissions.subprocess: local validation, build and test commands named by the project
permissions.interactive: required for exact candidate approval and every external side effect

governed: one central state machine routes exactly one stage owner at a time
candidate lock requires exact human confirmation
one page owns one intent and no normalized keyword alias overlaps
every page has two sources; sensitive claims have current trusted evidence
every page in the current change batch is human-reviewed; batch size is evidence- and capacity-bound
external actions require matching active authorization ids
deployment, telemetry, indexing and data are proved separately
no valid GSC data means diagnostics plus day-7/day-14 review, not growth or retirement
local tests, trigger eval, output eval, secret scan and public-claim guard pass

evidence_boundary.public_claim_policy: claim only what local validation, install proof, human review, or provider-backed evidence actually supports
